result.topic_en: Heading 'Anciennes questions non résolues' followed by the reprinted statement of question 1852 (from 1900, p. 288) about an articulated system of seven rigid rods forming a skew quadrilateral plus three rods from a point M.
result.transcription:
ANCIENNES QUESTIONS NON RÉSOLUES.

1852 (1900, 288). — On considère un système articulé composé de sept tiges rigides dont les quatre premières forment un quadrilatère gauche ABCD; les trois autres ME, MF, MG relient un point M à trois points E, F, G, appartenant respectivement aux tiges AB, BC, CD et fixes sur ces tiges.

questions.statement_fr: On considère un système articulé composé de sept tiges rigides dont les quatre premières forment un quadrilatère gauche ABCD; les trois autres ME, MF, MG relient un point M à trois points E, F, G, appartenant respectivement aux tiges AB, BC, CD et fixes sur ces tiges.
questions.statement_en: Consider an articulated system composed of seven rigid rods, the first four of which form a skew quadrilateral ABCD; the other three, ME, MF, MG, connect a point M to three points E, F, G belonging respectively to the rods AB, BC, CD and fixed on these rods.

result.notes_en: The page carries the section heading 'Anciennes questions non résolues' (Old unsolved questions), set between decorative rules, with no other editorial text. The statement of question 1852 appears to continue on the next page.
